label: New Zealand Aerial Mapping surveys the Richardson Range
summary: Piet van Asch began aerial survey work near Queenstown for the DSIR. This early commercial survey added systematic imagery to the national mapping record before the first NZMS 1 sheet was published in 1939.

sources.label: Matthew Wright, “van Asch, Henry Piet Drury”, Dictionary of New Zealand Biography, Te Ara, 2000
